sources.title: Darius Slay announces NFL retirement
sources.description: After an impressive 13 years in the NFL, former Philadelphia Eagles cornerback Darius Slay has announced his retirement from the game of football. The 35-year-old shared the following post on social media: Along with this message: Dear football, I wanna thank you for all you’ve done for me. I’ve been blessed to play the game […]
